prerequisites: Active knowledge of English, enabling fluent expression on topics related to university studies, interests, and fields of study.
Vocabulary and grammar corresponding to at least B1 level (GEN1 and GEN2 courses).

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the main ideas of comprehensible input on topics related to everyday situations, while studying or preparing for a future career.
Engage in conversation, describe facts, events and goals, and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans.
Communicate in English independently at a minimum B1 level.

assessment_rules: The exam has a written and an oral part. The written part tests knowledge of grammar and vocabulary. The oral part tests the ability to engage in conversation spontaneously, fluency of speech, pronunciation, and the ability to use grammar and vocabulary from compulsory literature. The student is required to score at least 50% in both parts of the exam.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
